Confirms my earlier count for quarterly.js. 17 call sites across 6 files still pass the second argument.

| File | Two-arg calls |
|---|---|
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 |

`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5. Every one of these passes `true` for the legacy rounding flag — worth checking whether any of them actually need rounding preserved before you drop the parameter.
